scenario: 面试：设计一个「句子校验器」——按一组规则(首字母大写、以标点结尾、无连续空格…)判断一句话是否合法。
scenario_en: Interview: design a sentence validator that checks a sentence against a set of rules (capital start, ends with punctuation, no double spaces...).
q: 动手写类之前，最该先澄清哪组问题？
q_en: What should you clarify before writing classes?
options: 规则集、fail-fast 还是收集全部错误、新规则可扩展性
错误提示用什么字体和颜色渲染给终端用户看
句子存 MySQL 还是 Postgres、要不要加全文索引
先写一个大 if-else 覆盖全部情况、之后再考虑重构
options_en: The rule set, fail-fast vs collect-all, and extensibility for new rules
What font and color to render the error message in for end users
Whether sentences go in MySQL or Postgres and whether to add a full-text index
Write one big if-else covering every case first and refactor later
optionExplanations: 对：规则集、fail-fast vs 收集全部、可扩展性——这三点直接决定类怎么设计。
错：渲染是 UI 细节，跟 OOD 类设计无关。
错：存储不是这道 OOD 题的核心。
错：一上来大 if-else 正是要避免的反模式(违反 OCP/SRP)。
optionExplanations_en: Right: the rule set, fail-fast vs collect-all, and extensibility directly shape the class design.
Wrong: rendering is a UI detail, unrelated to the OOD.
Wrong: storage is not the core of this OOD.
Wrong: a big if-else up front is the anti-pattern to avoid (breaks OCP/SRP).
why: OOD 先问清「有哪些规则、是遇错即停还是收集全部错误、以后加规则要不要免改老代码」——这三点决定你把规则抽成什么、校验器怎么聚合结果。
why_en: Clarify the rules, fail-fast vs collect-all, and whether adding rules must avoid touching old code — these shape how you abstract rules and aggregate results.
tradeoff: 先澄清规则集与扩展性(设计一次到位) vs 直接开写(起步快·每加一条规则都改老代码)

scenario: 你有很多条校验规则，还要能随时加新规则。
scenario_en: You have many validation rules and must be able to add new ones anytime.
q_en: How should you abstract a rule?
options: 定义 ValidationRule 接口，每条规则一个实现类
把所有规则写进 SentenceValidator 的一个大 validate() 方法
每条规则用一个全局布尔变量表示它的开关状态
规则硬编码进 if-else，需求一变就回来改这个方法
options_en: Define a ValidationRule interface; one implementation class per rule
Put every rule inside one big validate() method on SentenceValidator
Represent each rule as a global boolean flag holding its on/off state
Hard-code the rules into an if-else and edit that method whenever requirements change
optionExplanations: 对：一个公共接口 + 每规则一类，就能统一调用、独立测试、随意增删。
错：塞进一个大方法 → 加规则就改它，违反开闭原则、也难测。
错：全局布尔表达不了「怎么校验」的逻辑。
错：硬编码 if-else 正是要抽象掉的东西。
optionExplanations_en: Right: a common interface + one class per rule gives uniform calling, isolated testing, and easy add/remove.
Wrong: one big method means editing it to add a rule — breaks OCP and is hard to test.
Wrong: a global boolean cannot express the checking logic.
Wrong: a hard-coded if-else is exactly what abstraction removes.
why: 核心抽象=一个 ValidationRule 接口(每条规则实现 check(sentence)，返回错误或空)，每条规则是一个独立的类。这样校验器能统一调用、每条规则能单独测、增删规则互不影响。
why_en: The core abstraction is a ValidationRule interface (each rule implements check(sentence) → error or none), one class per rule. The validator calls them uniformly, each rule is tested in isolation, and adding/removing rules is independent.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把「一族可互换的算法/规则」各封装成一个类、实现同一个接口，调用方持有接口、运行时可换。这里每条校验规则就是一个策略
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Strategy pattern: encapsulate a family of interchangeable algorithms/rules as classes behind one interface; the caller holds the interface and can swap them. Each validation rule is a strategy.

termDefinitions.meaning: Python 没有 Java 那种 interface 关键字。表达「规则契约」的两种地道写法:①abc.ABC + @abstractmethod(强制子类实现 check);②typing.Protocol(结构化子类型,谁有 check 方法谁就算)。甚至靠 duck typing——任何有 check(sentence) 方法的对象都能用
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Python has no interface keyword. Two idiomatic ways to express the rule contract: abc.ABC + @abstractmethod (forces subclasses to implement check), or typing.Protocol (structural typing). With duck typing, any object having check(sentence) works.

tradeoff: 接口+每规则一类(可插拔·类数量变多) vs 单个大 validate(代码集中·每次改老代码)

scenario: SentenceValidator 要把一堆规则跑一遍并给出结果。
scenario_en: SentenceValidator must run a set of rules and produce a result.
q: SentenceValidator 的核心结构应该是？
q_en: What is the core structure of SentenceValidator?
options: 组合一个 List<ValidationRule>，遍历聚合成 ValidationResult
为每条规则在 SentenceValidator.validate 里写一个专门的 if 分支
让校验器继承每一条规则类，靠父类方法拼出校验能力
把每条规则的逻辑复制进 validate 方法里内联执行
options_en: Compose a List<ValidationRule>, iterate and aggregate into a ValidationResult
Write a dedicated if-branch for every rule inside SentenceValidator.validate
Have the validator inherit from every rule class and reuse the parent methods
Copy each rule's logic inline into the validate method
optionExplanations: 对：校验器只持有规则列表、统一遍历聚合——加规则只往列表里加，校验器代码不变。
错：每规则一个 if 又回到硬编码。
错：校验器不该继承规则，是「组合」它们。
错：复制逻辑违反 DRY、且不可扩展。
optionExplanations_en: Right: the validator just holds a list of rules and iterates/aggregates — adding a rule only appends to the list, the validator is unchanged.
Wrong: an if per rule is hard-coding again.
Wrong: the validator composes rules, it does not inherit them.
Wrong: copying logic breaks DRY and is not extensible.
why: SentenceValidator 用「组合」：持有 List<ValidationRule>，遍历 check 把错误收进 ValidationResult。加规则只往列表注册，校验器一行不改。
why_en: SentenceValidator uses composition: it holds a List<ValidationRule> and validate() iterates each check, collecting errors into a ValidationResult. Adding a rule just registers a new rule object; the validator itself never changes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让一个类「持有」别的对象(这里 validator 持有一列规则)来复用能力,而不是靠继承。更灵活:运行时能换、能增删,不被继承层级绑死
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Composition over inheritance: a class holds other objects (the validator holds a list of rules) instead of inheriting. More flexible — swap/add/remove at runtime, not locked into a hierarchy.

tradeoff: 组合规则列表(可插拔·多一层间接) vs 内联 if 分支(直白·加规则必改 validate)

scenario: 产品要加一条新规则:句子不能以连续两个空格出现。
scenario_en: Product adds a new rule: a sentence must not contain a double space.
q: 在这个设计里加这条规则要动什么？
q_en: What do you change to add this rule?
options: 新增一个 NoDoubleSpaceRule 类并注册进规则列表，别的都不改
在 SentenceValidator.validate 里加一个新的 if 分支来判断
改每一条已有规则的代码，让它们感知这条新规则
重写整个校验器以及全部已有的规则类
options_en: Add one NoDoubleSpaceRule class, register it in the list, change nothing else
Add a new if-branch inside SentenceValidator.validate to check for it
Edit every existing rule so they are aware of the new rule
Rewrite the whole validator and all existing rule classes
optionExplanations: 对：加规则=加一个实现 ValidationRule 的新类并注册——对扩展开放、对修改关闭(OCP)。
错：往 validate 里加 if 就是「改老代码」，违反 OCP。
错：新规则跟老规则无关，不该动它们。
错：整体重写完全没必要。
optionExplanations_en: Right: adding a rule = a new class implementing ValidationRule + register it — open for extension, closed for modification (OCP).
Wrong: adding an if inside validate edits old code, breaking OCP.
Wrong: the new rule is unrelated to old ones; do not touch them.
Wrong: a full rewrite is unnecessary.
why: 这就是开闭原则(OCP)的价值:加需求=加一个新类(对扩展开放),不改 SentenceValidator 和已有规则(对修改关闭)。反面(大 if-else)每次加规则都要改那个方法,越改越脆、越难测。
why_en: This is the payoff of the Open/Closed Principle: a new requirement = a new class (open for extension) without touching SentenceValidator or existing rules (closed for modification). The opposite (a big if-else) edits that method every time — fragile and hard to test.
tradeoff: 每规则一类(易扩展·类多一点) vs 大 if-else(集中·每次改老代码)

termDefinitions.meaning: 对扩展开放、对修改关闭:加新行为靠「加新代码(新类/新实现)」,而不是「改已有代码」。规则即插件是它的典型体现
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Open/Closed Principle: open for extension, closed for modification — add behavior by adding new code (new classes), not editing existing code. Pluggable rules are the classic example.

scenario: 前端想知道「哪几条规则没过、分别为什么」，不只是「合不合法」。
scenario_en: The client wants to know which rules failed and why, not just pass/fail.
options: ValidationResult：通过与否 + 全部错误列表
只返回一个 boolean 表示这句话通过或不通过
遇到第一条失败就抛异常，调用方靠 try/catch 去处理错误
返回一段拼好的中文提示字符串给前端直接显示
options_en: A ValidationResult: overall pass/fail plus the full error list
Just a boolean saying whether the sentence passed
Throw an exception on the first failure and let the caller handle it with try/catch
Return a pre-formatted message string for the frontend to display
optionExplanations: 对：调用方可按错误项分流——高亮对应输入框、或只取第一条写日志。
错：只回 boolean 丢失了「为什么、哪几条」的信息。
错：用异常表达「校验不过」是滥用异常;而且只暴露第一条。
错：返回拼好的字符串把展示格式写死进了业务层。
optionExplanations_en: Right: the caller can route per error — highlight the offending field, or log just the first one.
Wrong: a bare boolean loses which rules failed and why.
Wrong: using exceptions for validation failure is abuse, and only surfaces the first.
Wrong: returning a formatted string bakes display format into the business layer.
why: 返回结构化 ValidationResult(isValid + 错误列表)，而非裸 boolean 或异常。异常留给真正的意外，不用来表达业务校验结果。
why_en: Return a structured ValidationResult (isValid plus the error list) instead of a bare boolean or an exception — reserve exceptions for real faults, not for expressing a validation outcome.
tradeoff: 结构化 ValidationResult(信息全·调用方要遍历) vs 裸 boolean/异常(接口简单·丢失哪条为什么)

scenario: 决定校验器遇到不合法时的行为。
scenario_en: Decide the validator behavior on invalid input.
q: fail-fast 和 collect-all 怎么选？
q_en: Fail-fast vs collect-all — how to choose?
options: collect-all 收全部错误；fail-fast 遇错即停
两者语义完全一样，只是命名不同，随便选一个
fail-fast 永远更好，任何场景都应该优先用它
collect-all 必须改写每条规则的内部逻辑才能收集全部错误
options_en: collect-all gathers every error; fail-fast stops at the first
They mean exactly the same thing, only the name differs, pick either
fail-fast is always better and should be preferred in every scenario
collect-all only works if you rewrite the internals of every rule to gather errors
optionExplanations: 对：给用户看就 collect-all(一次列全好修);省算力/网关拦截就 fail-fast。都在校验器的遍历里控制,不动规则。
错：语义不同——一个全收、一个即停。
错：表单校验反而要 collect-all,fail-fast 体验差。
错：collect-all 只改遍历策略,不改单条规则。
optionExplanations_en: Right: collect-all for user-facing fix-it-all-at-once; fail-fast to save work or at a gate. Both live in the validator loop, rules unchanged.
Wrong: different semantics — one collects all, one stops early.
Wrong: form validation wants collect-all; fail-fast hurts UX.
Wrong: collect-all only changes the loop, not individual rules.
why: collect-all：跑完全部、返回所有错误——用户能一次改完，表单校验常用。fail-fast：遇第一条失败就停——省算力、安全网关拦截时用。这是校验器遍历层的选择，单条规则不变。
why_en: collect-all runs every rule and returns all errors — the user fixes everything at once (typical for forms). fail-fast stops at the first failure — saves work, good at a security gate. It is a choice in the validator loop; individual rules are unchanged.
tradeoff: collect-all(全部错误·体验好·多跑) vs fail-fast(即停·省算力·只见第一条)

scenario: 要给这个设计写单元测试。
scenario_en: You need unit tests for this design.
q_en: Why is this design easy to test?
options: 每条规则可单独喂输入断言；校验器用假规则测聚合
必须启动整个系统和数据库，才能测一条最简单的规则
规则都在一个大方法里，只能整体做端到端测试
没法写单元测试，只能人工逐条手动点一遍
options_en: Each rule is fed input and asserted alone; the validator is tested with fake rules
You must boot the whole system and database just to test the simplest rule
Rules live in one big method, so only end-to-end testing is possible
Unit tests are impossible; you can only click through each case by hand
optionExplanations: 对：一条规则=一个小类,给句子断言错误即可;校验器塞几条假规则就能测「聚合/收集」逻辑。
错：正因为解耦,单条规则无需启动系统。
错：那是大 if-else 的毛病,这个设计恰好避开。
错：解耦后单测非常好写。
optionExplanations_en: Right: a rule is a tiny class — feed a sentence and assert the error; the validator is tested with a few fake rules for the aggregation logic.
Wrong: because it is decoupled, a single rule needs no system boot.
Wrong: that is the big-if-else problem, which this design avoids.
Wrong: decoupling makes unit tests easy.
why: 接口+每规则一类让测试很好写:每条规则是小而独立的单元(给输入断言错误);SentenceValidator 用几条「假规则」就能测它的聚合/fail-fast 逻辑,不依赖具体规则。解耦=可测。
why_en: The interface + one-class-per-rule makes testing easy: each rule is a small independent unit (feed input, assert the error); SentenceValidator is tested with a few fake rules for its aggregation/fail-fast logic, independent of concrete rules. Decoupling = testability.

scenario: 复盘这道 OOD 的常见失分点。
scenario_en: Review common mistakes on this OOD.
q: 下面哪些是这道题的常见设计错误？（多选）
q_en: Which are common design mistakes here? (multi-select)
options: 把所有规则塞进一个大 validate() 的 if-else 里
在 SentenceValidator 里硬编码写死规则列表、外部无法增删
validate 只返回 boolean、丢掉「哪条、为什么」
用 ValidationRule 接口 + 每规则一类、校验器持有规则列表
options_en: Cramming all rules into one big validate() if-else
Hard-coding the rule list inside SentenceValidator so it cannot be changed from outside
validate returning only a boolean, losing which rule failed and why
Using a ValidationRule interface + one class per rule, with the validator holding a list
optionExplanations: 错误:规则一多这个方法圈复杂度爆炸,改一条容易碰坏另一条。
错误:测试时无法只塞两条假规则,也无法按租户/语言换规则集。
错误:前端只能显示「不合法」,无法把光标定位到出错的那一条。
这是正解:它同时解掉上面三个坑,面试时先说它再逐条对比。
optionExplanations_en: Mistake: as rules pile up the method's complexity explodes and editing one breaks another.
Mistake: you cannot inject two fake rules in a test, nor swap the rule set per tenant or language.
Mistake: the frontend can only say "invalid" — it cannot point the cursor at the failing rule.
This is the right answer: it solves all three pitfalls at once; state it first, then contrast.
why: 三个坑:大 if-else(违反 OCP/SRP)、写死规则列表(不可注入)、只回 boolean(丢「哪条为什么」)。正解=接口+每规则一类+注入列表+ValidationResult。
why_en: Three pitfalls: (1) all rules in one big if-else (breaks OCP/SRP); (2) a hard-coded rule list in the validator (not injectable/configurable); (3) returning only a boolean (loses which/why). The fix: a ValidationRule interface + one class per rule + an injected rule list + a ValidationResult return.
tradeoff: 每规则一类+注入规则列表(可扩展可测·类变多) vs 单方法 if-else(代码集中·每次改老代码)
